description: This Java source file defines an immutable class 'MergedJsonObjectMap' that models a Map interface merging two JSON objects and providing read-only access to their combined entries.

classes.name: MergedJsonObjectMap
classes.description: An immutable Map implementation that merges two JsonObjects, exposing combined keys and values with fallback semantics.

methods.name: of(JsonObject, JsonObject)
methods.description: Factory method to create a new MergedJsonObjectMap from two JsonObjects.

methods.name: of(Map<String, JsonValue>)
methods.description: Factory method to create a MergedJsonObjectMap from a given Map of String to JsonValue.

methods.name: size()
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the merged map.

methods.name: isEmpty()
methods.description: Checks if both underlying JsonObjects are empty.

methods.name: containsKey(Object)
methods.description: Checks if the merged map contains a key, considering both underlying JsonObjects.

methods.name: get(Object)
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key, searching first in jsonObject, then in fallbackObject.

methods.name: keySet()
methods.description: Returns the set of all keys in both jsonObject and fallbackObject.

methods.name: values()
methods.description: Returns a collection of all JsonValues from both underlying JsonObjects.

methods.name: entrySet()
methods.description: Returns a set of entries combining keys and values from both JsonObjects.

methods.name: equals(Object)
methods.description: Checks for equality based on underlying JsonObjects.

methods.name: hashCode()
methods.description: Computes hash code based on underlying JsonObjects.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object including its internal JsonObjects.
